title: Davao Conyo leads TikTok Awards PH 2026 winners heading to SEA tilt
summary: Filipino content creator Phillip Te Hernandez, popularly known as Davao Conyo, emerged as one of the biggest winners at the TikTok Awards Philippines 2026 after taking home the Creator of the Year…

blocks.text: Filipino content creator Phillip Te Hernandez, popularly known as Davao Conyo, emerged as one of the biggest winners at the TikTok Awards Philippines 2026 after taking home the Creator of the Year title. Hernandez, who is leading a roster of local awardees who will represent the country at the inaugural TikTok Awards Southeast Asia (SEA) 2026, expressed gratitude for the recognition during the awarding ceremony held in Makati City on Thursday, Nov. 5. “It’s a validation especially because I’m one of those creators na kahit branded ‘yung skits pinapanood pa rin nila.
